description: Symmetric sum of squared nearest-neighbor distances between batched 3D point clouds, with no point-count normalization and configurable batch reduction (Fan et al., §4.3).

examples.title: Train a point-cloud predictor with Chamfer distance

name: Chamfer Distance

parameters.additional parameters: No additional parameters are accepted; unknown keys in **params raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None; point-index ignoring is unsupported
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point prediction tensor shaped [B,N,3] with nonempty batch and point axes
parameters.reduction: none returns one summed distance per cloud, mean averages the batch, or sum totals it (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point target tensor shaped [B,M,3], with matching batch, dtype, and device; M may differ from N
